proposed_english: How dare you insult my sister!

note: Arabic ستفهم is future 'will understand'; English says conditional 'would understand'.
proposed_english: I don't believe she will understand.

note: English adds 'even', which is absent from Arabic.
تعني is not an unambiguous equivalent of impersonal 'it means' here; make the referent explicit.
proposed_english: I don't know what it means.

note: Arabic uses ذلك ('that') while English says 'this'.
proposed_english: I have to do this again.

note: عليي is malformed, and English is missing required 'to' before 'the bathroom'.
proposed_english: I have to go to the bathroom.

proposed_target: آمل أن يكون أخوك أفضل حالًا.
proposed_english: I hope your brother is better.

note: الحصول على المتعة is an unnatural calque; use idiomatic أستمتع.
proposed_english: I just want to have fun.

note: Current لِتُصْلح is morphologically wrong for passive 'be repaired'; rewrite naturally.
proposed_english: I must take my watch to be repaired.

proposed_english: I never wanted you to go.
